prompt:
Create a high-resolution design board showing THREE complete mobile screens for the Custra app: "Add product", "Complaints · Active", and "Complaints · Past". This continues the reference's approved VERY MINIMAL pastel design language: warm ivory/white, subdued sage primary buttons with DARK slate text, mist blue and muted peach status accents, navy/slate typography, quiet thin rules, simple consistent icons, no saturated royal blue. Preserve the Custra folded-C logo structure with its muted sage/teal recoloring. Use three tall straight-on flat 390x844-equivalent mobile screens side by side with small external captions, fine frame lines and readable text. No perspective phone hardware, dramatic shadows, decorative banners, dashboards or nested-card overload. All content fictional, simulated business support.

IMPORTANT NAVIGATION UPDATE: every screen's bottom navigation MUST read EXACTLY "Home", "Products", "Complaints", replacing the reference's old Appointments label. Home uses house icon, Products simple product-box icon, Complaints speech-bubble/document icon. Never use Appointments as a tab or page label. Label any upcoming visit "Next technician visit", never Next appointment.

SCREEN 1 Add product:
Compact top bar back arrow, existing small pastel Custra logo, title Add product below. Small intro can be omitted.
Minimal single-column form, no enclosing giant card. Clearly labeled controls:
Product type * : a slim dropdown filled "Television".
Brand * : slim dropdown filled "Samsung".
Nickname (optional): single-line empty input with placeholder "e.g. Living room TV".
Directly beneath, concise helper "Leave blank to use Samsung Television." This reflects exact default rule <Brand> <Product type>. Do not show nickname required.
A quiet subsection "Warranty details · optional". Compact Purchase date row with calendar icon and value "20 Oct 2025". Compact Warranty period field showing "24" and a visible unit selector "months", both on same line. Small text "Expiry: 20 Oct 2027 · Based on your entries". No verified badge, no default manufacturer guarantee, no serial-number demand.
Compact optional "Documents" row with paperclip and "+ Add invoice or warranty" text action. Tiny helper "PDF, JPG or PNG · up to 5 MB".
A large enough muted sage "Save product" button with dark label anchored above bottom nav. All fields within one viewport with normal comfortable touch sizes, no promotional content. Bottom nav Products active.
This layout is shared with edit mode: Add product/Save product becomes Edit product/Save changes, but do not add a separate edit screen to board.

SCREEN 2 Complaints Active:
Compact header existing Custra logo left, profile circle right. Page title "Complaints". Small "+ Register complaint" action at top, not a huge hero.
A slim segmented switch "Active" selected and "Past" unselected, muted sage active state, no third segment.
Below, three clear flat complaint rows separated by thin rules, no giant boxed cards. Each row with small category icon, product nickname, short issue line, one readable status chip, complaint ID and registration date, and ONE contextual action:
1 TV icon "Living room TV", "Screen won’t turn on", muted peach "Choose visit time", "#DEMO-1042 · 17 Oct", action "Choose time →".
2 Washing machine icon "LG Washer", "Water leaking during wash", muted blue "Registering", "#DEMO-1041 · 17 Oct", action "View progress →".
3 fridge icon "Kitchen fridge", "Not cooling properly", muted sage "Visit scheduled", "#DEMO-1038 · 16 Oct". A compact inline line "Technician visit · Mon, 19 Oct · 10–11 AM IST", action "View complaint →". Do not insert a fourth separate section duplicating this visit, no telephone button without technician data, no person assignment claims.
At foot a quiet "Demo support · Simulated technician visits" line.
Bottom nav Complaints selected, NOT calendar tab. Fit all meaningful content readable.

SCREEN 3 Complaints Past:
Same Custra/profile top bar and Complaints title, same "+ Register complaint" action, same segmented switch with Past selected.
Two compact flat past-complaint rows:
TV icon "Living room TV", "Sound cuts out", quiet sage text chip "Resolved", "#DEMO-0984 · 02 Oct", small "Closed after your confirmation", one "View complaint →" action.
Phone icon "Pixel Phone", "Battery drains quickly", quiet sage "Resolved", "#DEMO-0961 · 24 Sep", small "Closed after your confirmation", one View complaint action.
Do not invent cancelled, refunded, automatic closure or unimplemented reschedule actions. Past complaint records can open their saved timeline and historical visit details, but do not fill screen with an entire chat or new booking flow. Use modest whitespace rather than added decorative panels. Quiet simulation label near foot.
Bottom navigation Home Products Complaints with Complaints active.
Ensure a coherent minimal product with simple registration and scannable status. Render the original logo closely as reference, not a new symbol. The priority of the Add Product form is first identity, then optional warranty/docs. No real personal data.
notes: New navigation Home Products Complaints applied.
Nickname optional with Brand + Product type fallback; warranty/document inputs optional.
Add/Edit share layout with action/title variation; only Add rendered.
Active and past case lists use existing lifecycle concepts; Resolved display label maps to explicit user-confirmed CLOSED state.
Inline initial-product document upload requires saving product before using current document endpoint; implementation must handle the sequence and recover partial failures.
approval_scope: User approved Add/Edit Product layout and Active/Past Complaints preview: Looks great.
